description: PAPER forward trading, 24/7, of the Donchian breakout seed RETARGETED onto BTC and ETH against GBP (donchian_breakout_atr__ccore1: the seed's rules unchanged, universe crypto_core_v1), H4, priced from Coinbase Exchange PUBLIC candles and the public ticker (read only, no credential). Spot and unleveraged: the instruments cannot be shorted, so the seed's short breakouts are refused by the risk gateway (short_not_permitted) and journalled. Costs are COINBASE_UK_SPOT (60 bps taker per leg, lowest fee tier). Nothing reaches any exchange: orders fill at the paper venue. The seed has NOT passed the validation ladder on crypto or anywhere else; this run measures how it behaves forward, it does not endorse it. Every attempt row carries this file's sha256; changing any value here is a reviewed commit and a new sha.
